message.content:
**Texas Traffic Laws – Quick Reference**

| Area | Key Statutes / Regulations | Typical Penalties (examples) |
|------|---------------------------|------------------------------|
| **Speed Limits** | Tx. Transportation Code § 545.001 (speed limits on highways), § 545.002 (speed limits on non‑highway roads). | $50–$200 fine; points added to driver’s record; possible license suspension if points exceed threshold. |
| **Seat Belt Use** | Tx. Transportation Code § 545.021 (seat belt law). | $50–$100 fine; points added. |
| **Cell Phone Use** | Tx. Transportation Code § 545.041 (handheld device ban). | $50–$200 fine; points added. |
| **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | Tx. Transportation Code §§ 549.001–549.004 (impaired driving). | $500–$2,000 fine; up to 1 year jail; license revocation; mandatory alcohol treatment. |
| **Reckless Driving** | Tx. Transportation Code § 545.051 (reckless driving). | $500–$5,000 fine; up to 1 year jail; points added. |
| **Traffic Signal Violations** | Tx. Transportation Code § 545.011 (traffic signals). | $50–$200 fine; points added. |
| **Parking & Signage** | Tx. Transportation Code § 545.013 (parking regulations). | $25–$150 fine; towing/impoundment. |
| **School Bus Rules** | Tx. Transportation Code § 545.015 (school bus stop). | $250–$1,000 fine; points added. |
| **Commercial Vehicle Rules** | Tx. Transportation Code §§ 545.101–545.112 (commercial vehicle operations). | Varies widely; often higher fines and stricter licensing requirements. |

### How Points Work
- Texas uses a point system under the *Driver License Point System* (Tx. Transportation Code § 545.019).
- Accumulating 12 points within 3 years leads to a 30‑day suspension.
- Accumulating 18 points within 3 years leads to a 90‑day suspension.

### Common Enforcement Practices
- **Speed Cameras**: Many counties have automated speed enforcement cameras.
- **Red Light Cameras**: Used at high‑risk intersections.
- **Toll Road Enforcement**: Texas DOT monitors toll lanes for speeding and lane‑changing infractions.

### Resources for More Detail
- **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – [https://www.dps.texas.gov](https://www.dps.texas.gov)
- **Texas Transportation Code** – searchable online via the Texas Legislature’s website.
- **Local County Courts** – each county may have specific ordinances (e.g., Dallas County has its own parking code).

---
